scope: US planning catalog. Representative hardware families, not all retail SKUs. Hardware specifications are source-backed; workload allowances and complete-system price bands are authored planning estimates unless labeled otherwise.

usecases.name: Private everyday assistant
usecases.description: Questions, planning and personal notes.

usecases.name: Writing & editing
usecases.description: Emails, scripts, articles and copy.

usecases.name: Search my documents
usecases.description: Ask questions about a private library.
usecases.warning: Document retrieval needs local embedding models and an index. Offline research can only use material already downloaded.

usecases.name: Research & long reports
usecases.description: Compare saved sources and long documents.
usecases.warning: Fresh web research requires an internet connection. An offline model cannot know newly published facts.

usecases.name: Coding assistant
usecases.description: Write, review, explain and debug code.

usecases.name: Autonomous local agents
usecases.description: A local assistant coordinating tools and jobs.
usecases.warning: Autonomy needs a durable queue, tool permissions, memory admission limits, health checks and recovery. Hardware alone cannot guarantee reliable decisions or zero crashes.

usecases.name: Formula & ingredient design
usecases.description: Perfumery, ingredient research and calculations.
usecases.warning: Formula suggestions require authoritative ingredient data, applicable safety checks and physical testing. An AI score is not proof of safety or performance.

usecases.name: Math & science assistance
usecases.description: Reasoning, calculations and simulation support.
usecases.warning: Verify calculations with actual tools. Scientific simulations have separate CPU, memory and accelerator requirements.

usecases.name: Spreadsheet & data analysis
usecases.description: Clean tables, explain patterns and write analysis.

usecases.name: Tutoring & learning
usecases.description: Explanations, practice and feedback.

usecases.name: Text translation
usecases.description: Translate and revise supported languages.

usecases.name: Read scans & handwriting
usecases.description: Turn page images into searchable text.

usecases.name: Understand pictures & charts
usecases.description: Describe images and inspect visual details.

usecases.name: Understand video
usecases.description: Summarize clips and find relevant moments.

usecases.name: Generate images
usecases.description: Make images from written descriptions.

usecases.name: Edit & repair images
usecases.description: Replace objects, extend or transform pictures.

usecases.name: Generate video
usecases.description: Create short clips from text or a first frame.
usecases.warning: Video memory varies sharply with model components, duration, resolution and decoding. These are workflow-class allowances, not a claim that every H3 or Wan recipe needs this amount.

usecases.name: Generate 3D assets
usecases.description: Create shapes and textures for further editing.
usecases.warning: Generated meshes need geometry and scale checks before fabrication. Many current 3D pipelines rely on CUDA-specific extensions.

usecases.name: Upscale & restore
usecases.description: Enlarge images or restore photos and video.
usecases.warning: Restoration can invent texture and detail. More pixels do not guarantee greater fidelity to the source.

usecases.name: Speech transcription
usecases.description: Turn recordings into text and subtitle timing.

usecases.name: Generate spoken voices
usecases.description: Read text aloud with local voice models.
usecases.warning: Use voices and recordings you have permission to use. Runtime and license support depend on the selected model.

usecases.name: Generate music & sounds
usecases.description: Create music, ambience and sound effects.

usecases.name: Clean & separate audio
usecases.description: Reduce noise or separate instruments and voices.

usecases.name: Fine-tune an existing model
usecases.description: Adapt a language model with LoRA adapters.
usecases.warning: Fine-tuning here models language-model adapters, not full-weight fine-tuning or diffusion training. Verify the exact supported LoRA/QLoRA workflow.

usecases.name: Train a model from scratch
usecases.description: Language-model experiments at a selected scale.
usecases.warning: Training uses an 18-byte-per-parameter mixed-precision Adam state estimate plus activations, even when optimized inference weights are selected. Dataset scale, training time and engineering can dominate cost.

usecases.name: Serve an AI to a team
usecases.description: Keep local models available to multiple people.
usecases.warning: Parallel request capacity uses a conservative cache allowance, not a measured requests-per-second guarantee. Load-test latency and throughput before rollout.

hardware.name: CPU-only desktop
hardware.note: Example x86 desktop. Small text and speech models can run on CPU; large models can be impractically slow.

hardware.name: RTX 3080 desktop · 10GB
hardware.note: 10GB reference variant; a 12GB model also exists. Confirm your actual card. Used-system condition and warranty vary.

hardware.name: RTX 4060 Ti 16GB desktop
hardware.note: 16GB Ti variant, not the plain RTX 4060. Older generation; remaining stock varies.

hardware.name: RTX 5060 Ti 16GB desktop
hardware.note: 16GB Ti configuration. Price is a complete tower planning allowance, not a GPU-only MSRP.

hardware.name: Used RTX 3090 24GB desktop
hardware.note: Used-market planning only. Inspect cooling, power connectors and seller warranty.

hardware.name: RTX 4090 24GB desktop
hardware.note: Older generation. No NVLink. Extra host RAM can support offload but does not enlarge dedicated VRAM.

hardware.name: RTX 5090 desktop · 64GB RAM
hardware.note: Representative full 5090 tower. 32GB dedicated GPU memory; system RAM is separate. Confirm exact vendor pricing, BIOS and stock.

hardware.name: RTX 5090 desktop · 128GB RAM
hardware.note: Matched factory-validated memory matters. 128GB host RAM is not 128GB VRAM. No assumption of a cheap aftermarket memory kit.

hardware.name: RTX 5090 laptop · 24GB GPU
hardware.note: Laptop 5090 is 24GB, not the desktop 32GB card. Sustained power and cooling depend on the exact laptop.

hardware.name: RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell tower
hardware.note: 24GB ECC. Full-height edition; do not substitute SFF specifications. Dealer quote required.

hardware.name: RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell tower
hardware.note: 32GB ECC Workstation Edition. Lower board power than 5090, with the same nominal GPU memory capacity.

hardware.name: RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell · 48GB
hardware.note: 48GB ECC variant in a complete tower. Exact bill of materials and dealer quote required.

hardware.name: RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell · 72GB
hardware.note: 72GB ECC variant. CPU, host RAM and storage in this profile are planning choices, not a specific stocked system.

hardware.name: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell · 96GB
hardware.note: 600W Workstation Edition, 96GB ECC. Electrical/cooling assessment recommended. GPU-only NVIDIA listing was $16,000 and out of stock; complete-system quote needed.

hardware.name: Radeon RX 7900 XTX desktop
hardware.note: ROCm/HIP or Vulkan support is application-specific. Verify exact OS, GPU and framework versions.

hardware.name: Radeon AI PRO R9700 desktop
hardware.note: 32GB dedicated memory. ROCm release notes contain model/runtime-specific issues; CUDA-only extensions will not run unchanged.

hardware.name: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 · 128GB
hardware.note: Framework listed base $3,449 before SSD/OS. Fixed memory; GPU allocation and runtime support depend on firmware. Bandwidth is theoretical bus arithmetic.

hardware.name: NVIDIA DGX Spark · 128GB
hardware.note: NVIDIA listed $4,699, out of stock at research date. 128GB shared by CPU/GPU/OS, not 128GB free weights memory. Linux Arm packages must be checked.

hardware.name: ASUS Ascent GX10 · 128GB
hardware.note: Conflicting official starting prices and storage variants. Confirm a delivered quote. Fixed GPU/RAM, 180W published power input.

hardware.name: Mac mini M5 Pro · 64GB
hardware.note: 64GB configured estimate, not the 24GB starting price. Fixed memory. Confirm Metal working-set allowance on the actual machine.

hardware.name: Mac Studio M5 Max · 64GB
hardware.note: 40-core GPU configuration. Power is Apple's maximum continuous system rating, not measured inference draw.

hardware.name: Mac Studio M5 Max · 128GB
hardware.note: 40-core GPU variant, fixed RAM. Large memory does not establish compatibility with a particular CUDA video pipeline.

hardware.name: Mac Studio M5 Ultra · 256GB
hardware.note: Shared memory, not dedicated CUDA VRAM. Verify the exact model port and measured Metal working-set limit.

hardware.name: Mac Studio M5 Ultra · 512GB
hardware.note: Announced 512GB configuration, not immediate delivery. 36-core CPU / 80-core GPU; fixed memory.

hardware.name: MacBook Pro M5 Max · 64GB
hardware.note: Example 64GB Max configuration. Confirm exact GPU and power adapter. Sleep, lid settings and mobility affect always-on service.

hardware.name: MacBook Pro M5 Max · 128GB
hardware.note: 40-core GPU, shared fixed memory. Exact price and SSD configuration require a quote.

hardware.name: 4× RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q workstation
hardware.note: Lenovo PX class. 384GB aggregate is four separate 96GB allocations. 1,200W GPU-board total alone; 1,800W shown is a planning load, not PSU sum.

hardware.name: 8× RTX PRO 6000 server
hardware.note: 5U air-cooled. Up to 4,800W of GPUs; system load must be quoted. No automatic NVLink pooling for RTX GPUs.

hardware.name: Dual RTX PRO 5000 · 2× 72GB
hardware.note: Exxact Threadripper PRO platform, configured with two 72GB cards and 256GB ECC RAM. Complete-system allowance, not a seller quote. 1.5kW electrical planning reservation, not measured draw.

hardware.name: Dual RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q · 2× 96GB
hardware.note: Exxact 4U rackmountable workstation configured with two Max-Q cards. GPU boards total 600W; 1.5kW whole-system electrical allowance is not measured consumption. Exact BOM and quote required.

hardware.name: Dell R760xa · 4× L40S 48GB
hardware.note: OEM reference uses four L40S GPUs and 512GB RAM. 2U air-cooled rack server. 2.8kW provisioning allowance is not measured draw. Passive GPU cards depend on chassis airflow.

hardware.name: Lenovo SR650a V4 · 2× H200 NVL
hardware.note: Hybrid AI 221 reference: two 141GB H200 NVL, two-way bridge and 512GB RAM. 2U air-cooled; 3.2kW electrical allowance. 282GB aggregate requires supported sharding for a single model.

hardware.name: Lenovo SR675 V3 · 4× H200 NVL
hardware.note: 3U four-card H200 NVL PCIe configuration with AMD EPYC 9005; not the withdrawn HGX four-GPU board. 1TB host planning configuration, 5.2kW electrical allowance, delivered quote required.

hardware.name: DGX A100 · 8× 80GB
hardware.note: Legacy 6U platform. 640GB aggregate, not a single generic 640GB GPU. 200–240V and substantial airflow required.

hardware.name: DGX H100 · 8× 80GB
hardware.note: 8U, 10.2kW maximum system power. Distributed runtime and model support required for model sharding.

hardware.name: DGX H200 · 8× 141GB
hardware.note: 1,128GB aggregate HBM. Cooling, fabric, support and installed system quote must be assessed separately.

hardware.name: DGX B200 · 8× 180GB
hardware.note: 10U air-cooled, 1,440GB aggregate HBM, 14.3kW maximum. Per-model tensor/pipeline parallelism is still required.

hardware.name: DGX B300 · 8× 288GB nominal
hardware.note: Guide: 2,304GB nominal; marketing: 2.1TB. Planner conservatively uses 2.1TB before reserves. Confirm usable memory. 15kW electrical maximum.

hardware.name: GB200 NVL72 liquid-cooled rack
hardware.note: 48U liquid rack, about 13.4TB aggregate GPU memory. 132kW configured rack power; CDU, heat rejection, networking and site work extra.

hardware.name: GB300 NVL72 liquid-cooled rack
hardware.note: 72×288GB = 20,736GB nominal, rounded by vendors to 20–21TB. A $5m project is not guaranteed feasible after facility and support costs.

hardware.name: 8× AMD Instinct MI300X · 192GB each
hardware.note: OEM starting listing $278,664.87; exact configured BOM not verified. 1,536GB aggregate, up to 6kW GPU boards. 9kW planner load needs verification.

hardware.name: 8× AMD Instinct MI325X · 256GB each
hardware.note: Platform starting listing $245,580.19 does not establish all GPU configurations. 2,048GB aggregate. System power is an allowance, not PSU-nameplate sum.

hardware.name: 8× AMD Instinct MI350X · 288GB each
hardware.note: 8U air-cooled platform class, 2,304GB aggregate. Runtime, distributed software and delivered system quote required.

hardware.name: 8× AMD Instinct MI355X liquid server
hardware.note: Specific 4U liquid-cooled configuration; not all MI355X systems are liquid. GPUs alone up to 11.2kW. Qualified coolant infrastructure required.

hardware.name: 64× MI355X · eight-server rack
hardware.note: 18,432GB across eight separate server fabrics. Planner keeps each model replica within one eight-GPU node and its 3TB host-RAM domain. Reference rack power 120.36kW.

cloudOnly.reason: EC2/Neuron platform; cloud service rather than a local hardware purchase.
